Vitest test configuration. Node environment, globals enabled, tests in tests/**/*.test.ts, 15s timeout.
PostCSS configuration with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins.

sources.description: Phase 14.5A 13-layer production stack design for LyfeOS. All 13 layers documented with desired end state, current state, gaps, and risks. All layers BLOCKED.
UMH integration package init. Docstring: 'LyfeOS integration -- life optimization platform, direct Postgres polling.'

UMH integration manifest. Declares 3 signal types (quest_completed, daily_log_created, stats_updated), 4 capabilities (noop, create_quest, complete_quest, log_daily_reflection), 3 polled tables (quests, user_daily_logs, vision_goals), 30s default poll interval.

Typed query helpers for LyfeOS database tables. 4 dataclass row types (QuestRow, UserStatsRow, DailyLogRow, VisionGoalRow). Read helpers for fetching data since timestamps. Write helpers for inserting quests, updating quests, inserting daily logs. Outcome writeback helpers for umh_status and umh_outcomes audit table.
LyfeOS signal emitter. Builds SignalEnvelopes from polled database rows. Implements SignalEmitter Protocol. 3 builders: build_quest_signal, build_daily_log_signal, build_stats_signal.
LyfeOS capability handler. Implements CapabilityHandler Protocol. 4 capabilities: noop, create_quest, complete_quest, log_daily_reflection. Includes health check via SELECT 1.
Thread-safe in-memory correlation map for LyfeOS outcome writeback targeting. Maps correlation_id (UUID) -> LyfeOSWritebackTarget (user_id, table_name, row_id).
LyfeOS outcome receiver. Implements OutcomeReceiver Protocol. Dual writeback: source row umh_status update + umh_outcomes audit table insert. Severity ladder for status progression.

Operator corrections from current session. Key corrections: (1) Primary nav is Dashboard/Missions/AI/Chronilog/Profile NOT Systems as 5th tab. (2) NOVA is the default AI assistant name stored in aiAssistantName field, user-renamable. (3) LyfeOS deployed on Replit at lyfeos.net. (4) No Clerk dependency exists in code. (5) replit.md documents Helmet security headers, rate limiting mentioned but not confirmed in snapshot.
